LOCATION: interlibrary loan desk where a returned book unrolls a paper band the length of a forearm
sorting room where every parcel carries the stamps of every hand that held it
bakery counter where the sandwich comes with its credits: the roll, the onions, the cheese, each named to where it came from
convention hall of folding tables, each one a person who drew the thing they are selling
back office drawer of old routing bands, folded in thirds, kept behind bookplates
ANTAGONIST: the clean new band that erases every stop before it
the checkout that records the borrower and forgets the carriers
the stain with no note beside it
the word 'anonymous' where a small drawn owl used to be
MACGUFFIN: the band that says sorry: rain
the owl stamp nobody can trace
the receipt that credits every maker
the fresh band, dated, stamped, and held out with a pen
THREAT: the slip thrown out at check-in because it looked like trash
the tide line on the page edge with no one left who knows why
a chain of hands reduced to a single due date
the helper who never adds her own mark
CHARACTER: the loan specialist who reads a routing slip like a postcard, without hurrying
the student helper deciding whether a bad cat counts as initials
the library that draws an owl instead of writing its name forty times a week
the baker whose name rides on someone else's lunch
